- 30-minute follow-up dip into system design if time allows (Priyom)

Works for me — booking 45m on my calendar. I'll lead the modeling + prompt-to-code exercise. Please provision: CoderPad (pairing), and a small sample dataset (I can paste a CSV).

Quick ops notes:

- If Colab is needed, use the Drive link in the folder Neha shared.
- Scale of problem: single-file model task + one refactor, aim for ~30 minutes code + 10–15 minutes discussion.

I'll add the CoderPad session link once it's live.
Karthik
